candidate.educational_objective: Recognize valbenazine as a VMAT2 inhibitor indicated to treat tardive dyskinesia in adults.

options.B: Replace the client's antipsychotic therapy in all circumstances
options.C: Treat the underlying psychiatric disorder directly
options.D: Permanently cure all involuntary movements after a single dose

candidate.rationale: Current DailyMed labeling states that valbenazine (INGREZZA/INGREZZA SPRINKLE), a VMAT2 inhibitor, is indicated for treatment of adults with tardive dyskinesia. Therefore A is the best answer for this client. Valbenazine is not labeled as a replacement for all antipsychotic therapy or as treatment of the underlying psychiatric disorder, and the label does not describe a one-dose permanent cure.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Valbenazine is a VMAT2 inhibitor indicated for treatment of adults with tardive dyskinesia.
